advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Siiwtu ñalɗe kartal e @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt walla @listEnteredAt. Yeru: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' walla @endAt = none. Waɗ innde gesa keeriinga fuɗɗoriinga @ e nder maantore toɗɗugol.
advanced-filter-description: Siiwtorde ɓurnde yeeso yamirat winndude ɓoggol jogiingol waɗe ɗee: == != <= >= && || ( ) Boowal huutortee ko ceerndirgal hakkunde waɗe ɗee. A waawi siiwtaade galle keeriɗe fof so a winndii inɗe mum e kiisol mum. Yeru: Field1 == Value1. Tesko: So galle walla kiisol ngoodi boowal, a foti uddude ɗe e limle teelɗe. Yeru: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ngam diwde alkule ɗe kuutoragol ɗe gootal (' /), a waawi huutoraade \. Yeru: Field1 == I'm. A waawi kadi renndinde sarɗiiji keewɗi. Yeru: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. E laawol goowangol, waɗe fof paamate iwde nano yahde ñaamo. A waawi waylude lommbol ngol so a waɗii ƴoƴƴe. Yeru: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). A waawi kadi yiylaade galle binndol e regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Muulnu binndi, limre walla keɓal goɗngal tabitinaangal.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Lomtin kala feeñgol binndi nder binndi goɗɗi.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Ina waylita doosgol alkule e binndi ɗii.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Artir natto binndi ɗii tawa ɓolɗe ittaama e kombi gootol walla ɗiɗi.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Ina teela waylotoonde nde ngam fotde e naatgol ngol.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Waylotoonde innaande '%1' ina woodi tawo wonande mbaydi goɗndi: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Waylotoonde innaande '%1' ina woodi tawo no keɓal naatnaangal e gollirde '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Tiggu bulokuuji gootu%2 e nokku golle.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Yiylo e nokku golle. Ñoƴƴu Enter ngam fotondiral garoowal, Shift+Enter ngam fotondiral ɓennungal. Ñoƴƴu Escape ngam uddude yiylo tee fewnude e fotondiral jooni.
bots-none: Alaa bot tawaa. Bot ko golloowo e sarworde maa - jaŋtoowo AI, golle CI, skript - mo alluwal ngal okkata kartalle.
card-archive-pop: Kartal ngal yiytataako e doggol ngol caggal egginde ngal e mooftirde.
card-archive-suggest-cancel: A waawi artirde kartal ngal e mooftirde caggal ɗum.
click-to-star: Dobo ngam maantude alluwal ngal koode.
click-to-unstar: Dobo ngam ittude koode e alluwal ngal.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ko SuperAdmin tan, e domain Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: E WeKan nder Weddy, Cloud Panel ina golloo domain WeKan keewɗi gila e sarwor gooto, kala gooto e keɓe mum. E domain Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin ina toppitoo domain-ji ɗii e CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: E coktirgal CloudFlare API, domain mo zone mum woni e konte CloudFlare maa heɓat winndannde DNS proxy e seedantaagal CloudFlare Origin. Domain-ji goo heɓat seedantaagal Let's Encrypt. Coktirgal ngal ina danndaa e sarwor ngal, ngal hollirtaake kadi abada.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Alaa coktirgal CloudFlare API danndaangal: kala domain heɓat seedantaagal Let's Encrypt.
copy-card-link-to-clipboard: Natto jokkol kartal e alluwal ɗakkitorde
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Kolonji goɗɗi naatneteeɗi no galle keeriɗe binndi:
csv-mapping-description: Suɓo kolon fiilde jogiingol kala gallol kartal. Cuɓaaɗe ɗee ngaɗaama iwde e inɗe kolonji; wayl ko fof juumi, tee suɓo (alaa e fiilde) wonande gallol ngol fiilde ndee jogaaki.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Fiilde ndee alaa kolon wonande doggol. Suɓo gootol dow, walla winndu innde doggol gootol ngol kala kartal naatata.
csv-mapping-list-required: Winndu innde doggol ngol kala kartal naatata, walla suɓo kolon jogiingol doggol ngol.
delete-all-notifications-confirm: A yenanaa a yiɗii momtude tintine fof? Golle ɗee mbaawaa firteede.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Yottingol waawaa teeŋtineede; ƴeewto hade etaade kadi
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Jaɓoowo alaa walla konte mum daaƴaama
email-invite-register-text:
Jaɓɓorgal __user__,

__inviter__ noddii-ma to alluwal kanban ngam gollondiral.

Tiiɗno jokku jokkol les ngol:
__url__

Kod noddaango maa ko: __icode__

A jaaraama.
email-recovery-busy: Neldagol walla golle goɗɗe doggol ngol ina njokka. Hesɗitin tee eto kadi caggal waktu seeɗa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Haaytude ɓatakuuje fof wonɗe jooni e doggol sabbunde ngam keɓoowo oo? Loowdi mum maa momte tee waawaa artireede. Ɓatakuuje kese sosaaɗe caggal ɗaɓɓitannde ndee ina ndanndee.
email-recovery-description: Gorol gootol e kala keɓoowo. Yiylo huutoraade ID kuutoro. Loowdi ɓatakuuje e galleeji iimeel keɓoowo kolliraaka. Dartingol ina joga ɓatakuuje goodɗe e garooje; jokkugol ina eta neldude ɓatakuuje e doggol sabbunde jooni. Haaytugol ina momta ɓatakuuje naatnaaɗe e doggol sabbunde haa waktu ɗaɓɓitannde. So neldagol ina jokka, eto kadi caggal waktu seeɗa. Ɓatakuru nde neldagol mum fuɗɗiima waawaa artireede, tee neldagol ngol humpito mum laaɓaani ina waawi waɗeede kadi. Juume duumiiɗe e ɓatakuuje ɗe keerol etagol mum hewii ina keddoo ngam ƴeewteede. Etagol neldude ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum woorii ina fuɗɗina daawal etagol kesol tee ina reena dartingol goodngol.
email-recovery-empty: Alaa ɓatakuuje e doggol sabbunde walla keɓooɓe ɓe neldagol mum dartinaa.
email-recovery-failed: Golle ɗee mbaawaaka teeŋtineede. Hesɗitin doggol ngol tee eto golle ɗee kadi so ina waɗi haaju.
email-recovery-pending: Ina sabbii walla ina eta kadi
email-recovery-retry: Eto neldude kadi ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum woorii
email-recovery-retrying: Ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum ina ete kadi
email-recovery-superseded: Golle kuutoro ɓurɗe hesɗude lomtinii ɗaɓɓitannde ndee. Ngonka doggol ngol jooni ina holliree.
email-recovery-unavailable: Waawaa janngude doggol iimeel. Ƴeewto yamirooje jiiloowo e heɓaare sarworde.
email-resetPassword-text:
Jam __user__,

Ngam teeltude finnde maa kadi, dobo tan jokkol les ngol.

__url__

A jaaraama.
email-verifyEmail-subject: Ƴeewto ñiiɓugol ñiiɓirde iimeel maa e __siteName__
email-verifyEmail-text:
Jam __user__,

Ngam ƴeewtaade iimeel konte maa, dobo tan jokkol les ngol.

__url__

A jaaraama.
error-json-schema: Keɓe JSON maa ngalaa humpito moƴƴo e mbaydi moƴƴi
filter-on-desc: Aɗa siiwta karte e alluwal ngal. Dobo ɗoo ngam taƴtude siiwtorɗe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Ɗakku JSON yaltinal golle Asana ({ "data": [...] } iwde e yaltinal Asana walla GET /tasks). Golle renndintee e taƴe (memberships); golle timmuɗe njahata to Timmii.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: E Businessmap (ko adii Kanbanize), uddit Advanced Search, suɓo Configure results ngam suɓaade kolonji, aawto fiilde Excel ndee, refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Kolonji ina njanngee e inɗe mum en Engeleere (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): so konte maa ina huutoroo ɗemngal goɗngal, wayl inɗe diidol tiitoonde ngol e Engeleere tawo. Column ina wonta doggi tee Lane laabi; jom mum en, maantorɗe, goobu, ñalɗi, yowe e jokkole daddo ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en, tee Priority, Size, Type e kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-clickup: E ClickUp, yaltin golle ɗee no CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, walla yaltingol jiytol List walla Table e kolonji fof), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi, doggi ClickUp ina ngonta laabi, tee golle ina ngonta karte e golle pamaroore mum, halfinaaɓe, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, adanorde e sahaa.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ɗakku Kiisol Ceŋondiral (CSV) / Kiisol Tab (TSV) maa.
import-board-instruction-deck: Ɗakku JSON alluwal NextCloud Deck (alluwal jogiingal "stacks", kala stack jogii "cards" mum). Stacks maa ngonta doggi, tee cards maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-excel: Suɓo haayre .xlsx mbaydi WeKan (galle ɗe yaltinal Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Gorol aranol ko hoore.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Uddit fiilde .boardarchive tee ɗakku board.jsonl alluwal ngal, wondude e gorol yamre mum walla tawa alaa ngol. Sifa renndinde e gurupu e yiyngo alluwal wontata doggi, sifaaji cuɓagol goɗɗi ngonta maandeeji, taƴe binndi e kaɓirɗe maantagol ngonta sifaa e doggol ƴeewndagol, tee yowe danndetee. Nate e ɓeyditte naatnetaake.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ɗakku doggol JSON caɗeele __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Caɗeele maa ngonta karte renndinaaɗe e doggi Udditii / Uddataama.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ɗakku JSON yaltinaaɗo e Kanboard: geɗel jogiingel "columns" (walla golle jogiiɗe column_name) e doggol "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns maa ngonta doggi, tee tasks maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-kanri: E Kanri, uddit Import & Export tee suɓo Export individual board (walla Export all data), refti ɓortu fiilde .json ndee. Kolonji ina ngonta doggi tee karte ina ngonta karte, e cifagol mum, ñalngu timmugol, maantorɗe e gooɓi; golle kartal ina ngonta doggol ƴeewndagol. E yaltingol keɓe fof, alluwal aranal ngal naatnetee.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ɗakku mbaadi Leo (fiilde .leo). Taƴe gonɗe e dow fof ngontata doggi, taƴe les mum en ɗoon ngontata karte, binndol taƴre ndee wonata sifaa kartal ngal. Taƴe ɓurɗe luggaade ngontata doggi ƴeewndagol. Taƴe maantaaɗe naatnete no golle timmuɗe.
import-board-instruction-linear: E Linear, yaltin caɗeele ɗee no CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, walla yaltingol jiytol), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi, ekipuuji ina ngonta laabi, tee caɗeele ina ngonta karte e halfinaaɗo mum, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, caɗeele daddo, adanorde, kiisol, porose e cakkol.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Habbir happirde golle markdown (aada nde kaɓirɗe markdown-kanban wano Obsidian Kanban huutortoo): tiitooje "## Innde lislub", e kuutorɗe "- [ ]"/"- [x]" e ley. Tiitooje ɗen wonata lislub, kuutorɗe ɗen wonata kaarte; lislub e tolli ngu alaa checkbox kadi naatirta, wano kaarte uddaaɗe.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: E MeisterTask, dobo innde porose, suɓo Export project tee yaltin CSV, refti ɓortu ɗum. Pecce ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e yowe mum en, ñalngu timmugol, halfinaaɗo e maantorɗe; golle timmuɗe ina ndeena ñalngu timmugol mum. CSV winndaaɗo ngam naatnugol MeisterTask kadi ina gollira.
import-board-instruction-monday: E monday.com, uddit dosol alluwal ngal, suɓo More actions e Export board to Excel (e kesɗitine e subitems so a yiɗii), refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Kolon Status ina wonta doggi tee fedde ina ngonta laabi; yimɓe, ñalɗi, layluure sahaa e maantorɗe ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en, kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe tee kesɗitine ina ngonta yowe.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: E Nullboard, uddit alluwal ngal, suɓo Export this board... e dosol ngol, uddit fiilde .nbx ndee e taƴtorde binndi tee ɓortu ko woni e mum. Doggi ina ngonta doggi tee yowe ina ngonta karte: diidol aranol yowre ko innde kartal, tee ko heddii ko cifagol mum. Yowre raw ina heɓa maantorol raw. Fiilde jogiinde alluuje keewɗe ina naatna alluwal mum aranal.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: E Obsidian, uddit fiilde alluwal Kanban no Markdown (walla uddit fiilde .md e taƴtorde binndi), refti ɓortu ɗum fof. Laabi ina ngonta doggi e keerol karte mum en, karte ina ndeena maantorɗe mum en, ñalɗi, adanorde, galle e doggol ƴeewndagol, tee Mooftirde ndee wonta karte egginaaɗe e mooftirde.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ɗakku JSON renndo work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses maa ngonta doggi, tee work packages maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-opml: Ɓortu daɗɗol OPML, no Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq e kuutorɗe goɗɗe njaltinirta ɗum. Huunde dow ina ngonta doggi, ɓiɗɓe mum ina ngonta karte, yowre ndee wonta cifagol, tee huunde ɓurnde lugginde ina ngonta doggi ƴeewndagol. Huunde timmunde ina naatna no timmuɗe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Ɓortu fiilde Org mode, no Emacs, Orgzly walla Beorg mbinndirta ɗum. Tiitoonde dow ina ngonta doggi tee tiitoonde ɗiɗaɓe ina ngonta karte. TODO e DONE, adanorɗe, maantorɗe, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE e CLOSED ina ndeenee, tee kaɓirɗe ƴeewtagol e tiitoonde ɓurnde lugginde ina ngonta doggi ƴeewndagol.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: E Pivotal Tracker, uddit tabbere MORE porose ndee tee suɓo Export CSV (walla suɓo daarti tee suɓo Bulk Actions, CSV), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Kala ngonka daarti ina wonta doggol tee daarti ina ngonta karte, e mbaydi mum e maantorɗe, jom mum en, ɗaɓɓiiɗo, ñalɗi, yowe, golle e haɗooji; Estimate ina wonta Story points tee iterations ina ngonta sprints.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: E Quire, uddit dosol porose tee suɓo Export CSV, refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e golle pamaroore mum en no karte ɓiɗɗe, halfinaaɓe, maantorɗe no maantorɗe, ñalɗi fuɗɗoode, timmugol e timminaa, cifagol e adanorde no gallol keeriingol. Yowe e ceŋaaɗi ngalaa e CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: E Redmine, uddit Issues porose ndee, suɓo Also available in: CSV les doggol ngol, suɓo kolonji (All columns, e Description) tee yaltin, refti ɓortu CSV oo. Redmine ina inna kolonji e ɗemngal maa, njuu teel ɗemngal maa e Engeleere e My account hade yaltinde. Kala ngonka ina wonta doggol tee caɗeele ina ngonta karte, e tracker no maantorol, halfinaaɗo, binnduɗo, ñalɗi, gollal daddo e caɗeele jokkondirɗe; adanorde, fedde, yamre faandaare, sahaa hiisaaɗo, % Done e galle keeriɗe ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: E Super Productivity, uddit Settings, refti Sync & Backup, suɓo Export Data tee ɓortu ko woni e fiilde sp-backup .json ndee. Kala porose ina wonta laawol tee golle ina ngonta karte e To Do, In Progress, Backlog walla Done, e yowe mum en, maantorɗe, ñalngu timmugol, sahaa huuwiraaɗo e golle pamaroore; golle egginaaɗe e mooftirde ina ngonta karte egginaaɗe e mooftirde.
import-board-instruction-taiga: E Taiga, uddit Admin > Project > Export tee aawto dump porose oo (fuɗɗo firtude fiilde .json.gz), refti ɓortu JSON mum. Ngonkaaji user story ina ngonta doggi, user stories ina ngonta karte e golle mum en no golle pamaroore, epics e caɗeele ina keɓa laabi mum en, tee sprints, maantorɗe, yowe e jeyi keeriiɗi ina ngara kadi. Ceŋaaɗi naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: E Tasks.org, uddit Settings, Backups tee suɓo Export tasks, refti ɓortu ko woni e fiilde .json ndee. Doggi ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e yowe mum en, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, yowe e golle pamaroore; golle timmuɗe ina ndeena ñalngu timmugol mum, tee adanorde ina wonta gallol keeriingol.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ɗakku njaltudi task export: doggol JSON, walla golle gootel e kala gorol. Golle timmuɗe njaha to Done, project e priority ngonta maandeeji, annotations wontata yowe, tee depends wontata jokkondire e golle ɗe ngaddata faddoore.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: E Teamwork.com, hebbin mbaydi naatnugol golle Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) tee reen ɗum no .xlsx, refti suɓo fiilde ndee. Doggi golle ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte; gollal fuɗɗiingal e -, # walla > ina wonta gollel gollal dow mum (--, ## walla >> ina ɓura lugginde darnde gootal). Halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi e maantorɗe ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en; Priority, Estimated time e Complete ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: E TickTick, uddit Settings, Account, Backup & Import tee sos reenaande, refti ɓortu fiilde CSV ndee. Kala doggol TickTick ina wonta laawol tee kolonji mum ina ngonta doggi; golle ina ndeena maantorɗe mum en, ñalɗi, doggol ƴeewndagol, adanorde e golle pamaroore.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Ɗakku fiilde todo.txt: golle goote e kala gorol, no jaaɓnirgal todo.txt e jaaɓnirɗe jahduɗe mbinndirta ɗum. Golle timmuɗe ("x") njaha to Gasii, +project e @context mbaylitoo maantore, (A) waylitoo maantore arande, due: e t: mbaylitoo ñalɗi duttal e fuɗɗoode.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: E Vikunja, uddit Settings, suɓo Data Export tee aawto fiilde .zip nde neldetee maa, refti suɓo fiilde ndee, walla ɓortu data.json gonɗo e mum. Baageeji Kanban ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e maantorɗe mum en, halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi, cifagol, doggi golle no doggi ƴeewndagol e yowe; adanorde, keeri timmugol e timmugol ina ngonta galle keeriɗe. Ceŋaaɗi naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-wrike: E Wrike, yaltin porose walla dosiyee e Excel, walla hebbin mbaydi naatnugol Excel Wrike, refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Diidi dosiyee e porose ina ngonta laabi, Status ina wonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e Key mum, gollal daddo, halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi fuɗɗoode e timmoode, jokkondire e cifagol; Priority, Duration e kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Ɗakku JSON yaltinal doggol ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages maa ngonta doggi, tee items maa ngonta karte.
import-file-label: Suɓo fiilde yaltingol, walla ɓortu binndi mum les:
import-members-mode-map: Suɓo kuutoro gonɗo wonande kala gooto e maɓɓe
import-members-mode-placeholder: Jogit ɓe no huutorɓe nokkol e inɗe mum en, ngam jokkondirde ɓe e huutorɓe goonga caggal
import-too-large: Fiilde ndee ɓurii mawnude ngam naatnude nde laawol gootol. Senndu nde e fiilde ɗe ɓuri famɗude, wayno e golle walla e ñalawma, naatnu kala gooto.
instance-desc: Kuutoro kala seŋiiɗo e oo WeKan ena waawi yiide ngal alluwal. Ngal hollirtaake hay sahaa e yimɓe ɓe seŋaaki. Ko yimɓe ɓeydaaɓe e alluwal ngal tan mbaawi taƴtude ngal.
just-invited: A noddaama jooni tan to alluwal ngal
list-permissions-desc: Ko kala darnde waawi waɗde e ndee doggol, ko ɓuri ko alluwal ngal yamiri. Jiiloɓe alluwal mbaawi taƴtude sahaa kala.
list-select-cards: Suɓo karte fof e doggol ngol
muted-info: A heɓataa tintinol hay gootal baɗte bayle e alluwal ngal
name: Innde
notification-delivery-grouping-all: Kala ko foti nelde e mesaas gooto
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Yuɓɓinaaɗo laaɓtude: alluwal, moye, kartal e binndi ɓurɗi tiiɗde
org-sync-members-from-auth: Jahdin terɗe iwde e carwinoowo goongɗitingol
private-desc: Alluwal ngal ko suturo. Yimɓe ɓeydaaɗe e alluwal ngal tan mbaawi yiyde e waylude ngal.
public-desc: Alluwal ngal ko peɛnangol. Kala jogiiɗo jokkol ngol waawi yiyde ngal, tee ngal maa yiyto e jiylorɗe hono Google. Yimɓe ɓeydaaɗe e alluwal ngal tan mbaawi waylude ngal.
r-add-actinguser-member: Ɓeydu on gollotooɗo waɗi ndee sariya wonande aandiiɗo
r-blocks-conflict: Sariya ngal waylaama tuma a taƴtotonoo. Loowto sariya reenaangal ngal hade reenude.
r-blocks-help: Jokkondir dartinoowo gooto e gollal gootal. Daas bulokuuji iwde e boornde kuutorɗe. Huutoro taƴtorde fomiyeer ngam cuɓaaɗe ɓurɗe yaajde.
r-blocks-invalid: Jokkondir dartinoowo gooto tan e gollal gootal. Ittu bulokuuji ceertuɗi walla ɓurɗi hade reenude.
r-blocks-permission: Yamiroore jiiloowo alluwal ina waɗi ngam taƴtude sariyaaji.
r-blocks-unavailable: Keɓe sariya ngal ngalaa. Huutoro taƴtorde fomiyeer ngam ƴeewtaade sariya ngal.
r-cron-invalid: Yiyannde cron ina jogii nokkuuje joy: hojom waktu ñalnde lewru ñalnde yontere.
r-d-move-to-bottom-gen: Dirtin kartal to les doggol mum

r-import-workflow-note: Naatnu doggol golle jiyotooŋgol yaltinaangol iwde e n8n walla Node-RED. Noddi hurminooɓe/golle annditaaɗe maa njokke e kuule WeKan; noddi ɗi njokkaaka maa jaŋte.

r-remove-all: Ittu terɗe fof e kartal ngal

r-trigger-vars-hint: Galli doggol, laawol, tiitoonde, doggol ƴeewndagol e kuutortooɗo ina jaɓa kadi {creator}, {assignees}, {members} e {customField:Name}. Kiisol mum en ina janŋee e kartal so sariya ina ƴeewtee.
r-vars-people-hint: Kadi: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (inɗe kuutortooɓe e binndol, ñiiɓirde iimeel e gallol keɓoowo) e {customField:Field name}. Ɗee kadi ina golla e inɗe terɗe fedde, doggi e laabi e golle goɗɗe.

r-when-a-card-title-or-description-conta: So tiitoonde walla fillayle kaatoo woni e
r-workflow-help: Daas hurminoowo e golle to mahirgel, kisa ɓeydu laawol ngol. Daas golle dow laawol gonɗol ngam waylude ko ngol waɗata.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Laawol golle Wrike ko doggol ngonkaaji, kala gooto e fedde Active, Completed, Deferred walla Cancelled. Yaltingol ina winnda doggi alluwal ngal no gootol, innaaɗo e innde alluwal, e JSON mo API Wrike artirta wonande laabi golle: sos laawol golle ngol e Wrike hade naatnude yaltingol Excel Wrike alluwal ngal, ngam ngonkaaji mum ngollora. Naatnugol ina janngi JSON ɓortaaɗo dow, iwde e WeKan walla e GET /workflows Wrike, e alluwal cuɓaangal: ngonka mo alaa doggol ina wonta doggol, tee sariya ina maanta kartal no timmungal so ngal eggini e ngonka Completed walla Cancelled tee no timmaani e ngonka Active walla Deferred. Sariyaaji automasiyoŋ Wrike e hoore mum waawaa yaltineede e Wrike.
